_note: DEVELOPMENT / TEST RULES ONLY. These are NOT official ICD-11 rules. They are clearly-labelled placeholder rules for development and testing. Configure ICD11_RULES_PATH env var to load official rules when available.

rules.description: TM2/NAMASTE/ICD-11 code must start with a recognised prefix
rules.message: Code does not start with a recognised AYUSH/TM2/ICD-11 prefix.
rules.corrected_suggestion: Verify the code against the NAMASTE / ICD-11 TM2 chapter or the local terminology database.

rules.description: Display name must not be empty
rules.message: Condition display name is empty or missing.
rules.corrected_suggestion: Provide a non-empty display name for the condition.

rules.description: Code must not be null when system is specified
rules.message: A coding system was specified but no code was provided.
rules.corrected_suggestion: Provide a code for the specified coding system, or remove the system reference.
